definitions.gloss: to plateau, to stagnate, to level off, to fail to grow
definitions.explanation: To stop growing or improving after a period of progress. Used for sales, skills, grades, economic indicators, and personal development.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{伸|の}び{悩|なや}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{伸|の}び{悩|なや}んで⟦{焦|あせ}っている→焦る：04619_aseru⟧。
examples.english: My grades have stagnated and I'm getting anxious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{伸|の}び{悩|なや}む⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: With the economic recovery stalling, new measures are being called for.

notes:
CONJUGATION: {伸|の}び{悩|なや}む is a godan verb (む row). Te-form: {伸|の}び{悩|なや}んで.

COMPOSITION: ⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (to grow, to extend) + ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ (to worry, to struggle). The combination means "to struggle to grow" — growth that has hit a wall.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{伸|の}び{悩|なや}む (sales stagnate)
- ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{伸|の}び{悩|なや}む (grades plateau)
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{伸|の}び{悩|なや}む (economy stagnates)
- {伸|の}び{悩|なや}み (noun form: stagnation, plateau)
